rn.project.inspect.outcome: Initialize and inspect a local React Native project; serve project context and collect diagnostic/support reports. Beta covers fixture-based local operation, not every host toolchain or model provider.
rn.project.inspect.limitations: Host-toolchain checker doubles isolate diagnostics formatting. No claim of native builds, remote providers, SSO, certification, or model quality.

rn.policy.check.outcome: Evaluate local source against configured RN policy and return actionable findings, including policy failures through the Core harness.
rn.policy.check.limitations: Local fixture findings only; not a security audit or certification.

rn.generated-file.repair.outcome: Bound generated-file repair attempts and refuse unchanged invalid output before writes. Model responses are scripted in qualification; model quality is not guaranteed.
rn.generated-file.repair.limitations: Scripted model dependency; checks real policy/repair orchestration and refusal, not an autonomous real-provider outcome.

rn.feature.workflow.outcome: Run the local feature workflow orchestration and persist its reports. Beta qualification uses dry-run fixtures and scripted intent; generated production feature quality requires human review.
rn.feature.workflow.limitations: Dry-run persistence with scripted intent; no unqualified end-to-end production feature promise.

rn.analysis.outcome: Generate deterministic project engineering reports. Individual report implementations exist; cross-project and customer qualification remain incomplete.

rn.model-generation.outcome: Configure model providers and request code or document generation, subject to provider availability, explicit network configuration, and review.

rn.knowledge.outcome: Store local project knowledge and inspect configured Git-based sharing. Hosted cloud sync and qualified cross-project intelligence are not included.

rn.build-distribution.outcome: Plan or execute explicitly configured build archival and distribution. Store credentials, native toolchains, and remote delivery are not qualified by local tests.

rn.device-and-sandbox.outcome: Inspect rendering, performance, device integrations, and configured process isolation. Not a certified security boundary or air-gap guarantee.

rn.upgrade-and-fix.outcome: Diagnose and propose or apply bounded upgrades and fixes; verification must be reviewed in the target project.

rn.evaluation.outcome: Run committed local benchmark scenarios and inspect demonstration or evaluation reports; demonstrations are not production success evidence.

rn.commercial-information.outcome: Read current RN lifecycle and plan information; this informational surface does not grant product entitlements.

rn.enterprise-controls.outcome: Planned SSO/SAML and security qualification; no certification, guaranteed isolation, instant offline revocation, or unbuilt control is sold.

rn.hosted-sync.outcome: Planned hosted cloud sync and qualified cross-project intelligence; existing Git sharing is experimental and separately described.

sdk.ios.outcome: Planned native iOS SDK; no purchase or future-product grant.

sdk.android.outcome: Planned native Android SDK; no purchase or future-product grant.

sdk.flutter.outcome: Planned Flutter SDK; no purchase or future-product grant.

sdk.python.outcome: Planned Python SDK; no purchase or future-product grant.
